Strongman Robert Oberst joins Joe Rogan for episode 1321 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Oberst, a giant of the World's Strongest Man circuit, is known as much for his humor and huge meals as for his lifts. Big man, big talk is the order of the day.

Oberst explains the strong life: training that bends bars, eating that stuns waiters, and injuries that come with both. He shares stories from contests around the world and the odd brotherhood of giants. Rogan, a lifelong lifter, swaps gym lore with him. Lifters and the strong at heart get a champion's cheerful account of extreme strength.
